text: I'll look at the pagination code.
The bug is in `total_pages` using floor division. Let me view the file to confirm.
Confirmed: `total_pages` uses `//`, so 11 items with size 5 yields 2 instead of 3. I'll switch to ceiling division.

args.summary: The bug was in `Page.total_pages` in library/pagination.py, which used floor division (`total_items // page_size`). With a partial trailing page this undercounted pages (e.g. 11 items at size 5 gave 2 instead of 3), so `has_next` returned False one page early and the last partial page was unreachable. I changed it to ceiling division (`-(-total_items // page_size)`), keeping the existing zero-items case returning 0. The full test suite passes (29 tests).
